package targetcatalog

import (
	"context"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type discoveryCatalogStub struct {
	stacks []string
	limit  int
}

func (stub *discoveryCatalogStub) DiscoverByStacks(_ context.Context, stacks []string, limit int) ([]domain.LearningTargetDefinition, error) {
	stub.stacks, stub.limit = append([]string(nil), stacks...), limit
	return []domain.LearningTargetDefinition{{
		Ref:   domain.TargetRef{Type: domain.TargetCapability, Key: "javascript.dom-events", Version: "v1"},
		Title: "DOM events", Description: "Handle DOM events",
	}}, nil
}

func TestDiscoverReturnsBoundedCanonicalVocabularyForNormalizedStacks(t *testing.T) {
	catalog := &discoveryCatalogStub{}
	result, err := (Discover{Catalog: catalog}).Handle(context.Background(), []string{"JavaScript", "css", "javascript"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(catalog.stacks, []string{"css", "javascript"}) || catalog.limit != 200 || len(result) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("stacks=%v limit=%d result=%+v", catalog.stacks, catalog.limit, result)
	}
}

func TestDiscoverRejectsInvalidStackCode(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := (Discover{Catalog: &discoveryCatalogStub{}}).Handle(context.Background(), []string{"../../escape"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected invalid stack code to be rejected")
	}
}
